title: Align memory refusal guidance with explicit history intent
outcome: Memory refusal remedies lead to the intended current or explicitly historical read without misleading advice or an automatic history nudge.
acceptance: After an ordinary partial-revise refusal, suggested reads use the current full memory without implicitly opting into history navigation
After an explicit missing-history read, CLI and MCP recovery advice accurately describes a usable read and its history behavior; advice and next hints agree
Behavioral coverage follows the relevant refusal suggestions and preserves existing revision-conflict and missing-section recovery
